⌈
Service Name
Nm_CoordReadyToSleepCancellation
Syntax
void Nm_CoordReadyToSleepCancellation (
NetworkHandleType nmChannelHandle
)
Service ID [hex]
0x1f
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
nmChannelHandle
Identification of the NM-channel
Parameters (inout)
None

CoordReadyToSleepCancellation.⌋
